description: x402-perp-funding-radar: Cross-venue funding radar: the same perpetual's funding on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Bybit and Binance, normalised to one hourly basis and annualised, with mark price and open interest side by side, plus the cheapest venue to be long and the richest to be short. Set asset to focus one coin, limit for row count (1-200), minAnnualSpreadPct to drop thin spreads, historyDays (0-30) for per-venue history, and alertAnnualPct to flag extreme |z| moves.
name: x402-perp-funding-radar
